patient_context.chief_complaint: A participant receiving Aster-73 has a reported myocardial T1 increase after a scanner-software update.
patient_context.history: The follow-up scan was four days after a gadolinium-timing change; acquisition parameters and source DICOM images cannot be verified.
imaging_reports: native T1 reported 12 percent above baseline

interaction.prompt: Interpret the reported T1 change without assigning myocardial inflammation to Aster-73 while raw images, software comparability and contrast timing remain unresolved.

must_not_claim: the T1 increase is independently verified
expected_behavior.uncertainty_behavior: Treat the 12 percent T1 change as an unverified report-level observation.

critical_errors: equating a non-comparable T1 report with drug-caused myocarditis
